note: The look and story of the Learn path, one theme per level. Read by tools/build-path.py (never edit data/path.js). Units are named by id (h1u1 = HSK 1 unit 1). Chinese lines get their pinyin from the build. Culture notes are kept to things that are generally true; have a native speaker look over the Chinese.

1.name: One day in a new city
1.blurb: You arrive off the morning train, and by evening you are chatting with everyone. Each unit is one moment of the day.

phases.title: Morning
phases.line: The train pulls in. Someone on the platform is waving: your host.

phases.title: Noon
phases.line: Lunch is loud, warm and full of new people to meet.

phases.title: Afternoon
phases.line: Find your way across town, sit in your first class, then breathe out.

phases.title: Evening
phases.line: Lanterns come on. Everyone is out, and you can finally join in.

h1u1.scene: The train pulls in and your host is waving on the platform.

h1u2.scene: In the taxi queue your host asks who you are, and you ask what things are.

h1u3.scene: At the front desk: your name, and what is this and that.

h1u4.scene: Your room number, the price of the room, how many bags.

h1u5.scene: Your host introduces friends and family.

h1u6.scene: The menu is on the wall: big, small, hot, good.

h1u7.scene: What time is it? When is the next bus? Plan the day.

h1u8.scene: Order lunch, ask the price, pay.

h1u9.scene: Where is the school? How do we get there?

h1u10.scene: Your first Chinese class, and a phone full of new apps.

h1u11.scene: After class: the weather, hobbies, how you feel.

h1u12.scene: At the night market: what you do, can do and want to do.

h1u13.scene: Dinner with everyone, and a sentence that joins it all together.

2.name: The line
2.blurb: Ten stops on one line. Each station has one character to remember it by, and a ticket note from the platform.

note.text: Chinese has separate words for relatives on your mother's side and your father's side, like 奶奶 (father's mother) and 外婆 (mother's mother).
Dates run big to small: year, month, then day. 2026年11月12日.
Many meals in China are shared. Dishes go in the middle of the table and everyone takes some.
In many homes people change into slippers at the door.
People often give directions with north, south, east and west as well as left and right.
China has the longest high-speed rail network in the world.
In many parks you will find people exercising in the morning: tai chi, dancing, stretching.
A modest reply to a compliment is 哪里哪里 (nǎli nǎli), which means roughly: not at all.
To compare, use A 比 B + adjective: 今天比昨天冷.
Chinese happily uses both halves: 因为……所以…… is because … so …, in one sentence.

3.name: A semester in Hangzhou
3.blurb: You spend a semester studying in Hangzhou with your classmate 梅 (Méi). Every chapter opens with a short chat that uses the words of that unit.

lines: Thanks for coming to pick me up.
How much fruit do you want to buy?
I want two kilos of apples.
The tenth of October. Autumn has come.
How long do you study every day?
I study for an hour every day.
Let's go and eat Hangzhou food.
Good, I would like fish and rice.
太漂亮了！我们走过去吧。
放假了，你想去哪里旅游？
The break has started. Where do you want to travel?
I want to take the train to Beijing.
明天有考试，你复习了吗？
There is an exam tomorrow. Have you revised?
Not yet, I will revise right now.
真的吗？我第一次看到雪。
Really? It is my first time seeing snow.
今天晚上有晚会，你来吗？
There is an evening party tonight. Are you coming?
Of course! I will bring a gift.
I have a bit of a fever, and a headache too.
Do you think Chinese is hard?
我觉得很有意思，但是有点难。
I think it is very interesting, but a little hard.
春天来了，我们去爬山吧。
Spring is here. Let's go climbing.
OK, I will bring the water.
How is the tea in this shop?
Very tasty, and the shop is clean too.
如果明天不下雨，我们去哪里？
If it does not rain tomorrow, where shall we go?
为了看花，我们去公园吧。
To see the flowers, let's go to the park.
你不但会说汉语，而且写得很好。
You not only speak Chinese, you write it well too.
Thank you for always helping me!
